title: A moment of reflection
desc: How do you evaluate today's session? Your feedback helps us adapt the app to you.
privacyNotice: Submitting this form sends your answers on this page, together with a randomly generated identifier not linked to your name, the app version you used, your language, theme, and your active comfort settings, to a server, stored solely for the evaluation of this thesis. No names, contact details, or exercise content are transmitted.

nasa.mentalDesc: How much mental and perceptual activity was required?
nasa.physicalDesc: How much physical activity was required?
nasa.temporalDesc: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?
nasa.performanceDesc: How successful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do?
nasa.effortDesc: How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance?
nasa.frustrationDesc: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed, and annoyed were you?
